hints.title: Nine Permissible Digits
hints.text: Removing the digit nine leaves digits zero through eight available, exactly nine distinct symbols.

hints.title: Counting in Base Nine
hints.text: The natural counting order of numbers without the digit nine is isomorphic to standard positional base nine representation.

hints.title: Radix Conversion
hints.text: Convert the input integer n to base nine by repeated division by nine, collecting remainders and formatting the result as an integer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Radix conversion mapping the n-th number directly into base 9.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating every integer and checking for digit 9 takes O(N log10 N) which times out for large n.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Base 9 representation maps rank directly to digit sequences in logarithmic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice that skipping digit 9 leaves exactly 9 available digits, which is equivalent to base-9 counting.
